_source: Scraped from https://aueshah.com/ — official Noor Collection product pages.
_note: Limited edition: 143 pieces worldwide per SKU. Not publicly listed; private viewing by appointment only. All pieces are 925 sterling silver with 18-carat gold plating, zircon-set, Mughal jali-inspired.

pieces.name: The Noor Ring
pieces.stones: pear-shaped zircon center with pavé brilliant-cut zircon border
pieces.description: Built on Mughal arch geometry, the Noor Ring rises from an open jali base cut with scrollwork visible through the lattice. A single pear-shaped zircon sits suspended within a pointed oval frame at the crown, hand-set, centered. A pavé border of brilliant-cut zircons traces the inner frame. The outer edges extend into four pointed lobes — a seal-like crest profile that sits wide and flat against the hand.
pieces.narrative: Love outlasted the distance. 1,096 kilometres once existed between two people who refused to let it matter — he measured the distance, then made it the price of a ring.

pieces.name: The Noor Bracelet
pieces.stones: brilliant-cut pavé-set zircons with open-set zircon at the center of each panel
pieces.description: A heritage cuff of articulated square jali panels, hand-linked. Open-cut Mughal lattice with pavé-set brilliant-cut zircons at every edge and corner; one brilliant-cut zircon open-set at the center of each panel, visible through the metalwork from every angle. The cuff conforms to the wrist as it moves.
pieces.narrative: He spent more than a month counting every 'I love you' across every medium, every hour, every distance. When he reached 5,098, he made it the price — then built it into this cuff.

pieces.name: The Noor Earrings
pieces.stones: 2 pear-shaped zircon anchors, 5 free-hanging teardrop zircons per earring, brilliant-cut pavé border
pieces.description: Two stacked jali panels per piece, open-cut so metal recedes and stone remains. Two pear-shaped zircons anchor each panel; five free-hanging teardrop zircons descend from the lower panel, the largest at the center, graduating in size toward each side. Shoulder-length drops.
pieces.narrative: Two pieces, one person — always together. Born the same year, made for each other.

pieces.name: The Noor Necklace
pieces.stones: pavé-set brilliant-cut zircons with thirteen free-hanging pear-shaped zircon drops
pieces.description: A collar necklace inspired by Mughal jali openwork and Pakhtoon traditional teardrop stone design. A center stone with graduating zircons, thirteen pear-shaped drops hanging freely along the lower edge, and pavé-set stones throughout.
pieces.narrative: The Noor Necklace is reserved only for those who know that the most precious of things are kept closest to the heart — a name coded in numbers: 11 for N, two 00 for O-O, 9 for R.

pieces.name: The Noor Tiara
pieces.stones: pear-shaped zircons in Pakhtoon teardrop silhouette
pieces.description: A heritage headpiece built on Mughal jali openwork — pear-shaped gems rising in a balanced lattice. Each stone sparkles with intended brilliance; every curve, rise, and hand-set zircon reflects meticulous craftsmanship. Feeling should never outshine refinement.
pieces.narrative: Where legacy chooses you. Built to last, meant to mean something — 143, the numerical code for 'I love you'.
